claim: UDA planning material reports roughly 6,000 local and foreign tourists plus pilgrims per day in Kandy, but Run17 did not locate a city-level series separating arrivals, day visitors, pilgrims and average length of stay.

metric.denominator: combined daily local/foreign tourists and pilgrims in UDA profile
metric.period: UDA planning baseline; exact year unclear
metric.basis: UDA city profile; SLTDA national arrival series rejected as wrong geography for city-stay measurement
metric.source_definition: mixed visitor/pilgrim flow; not tourist arrivals or average length of stay

bounded_by: No tourism-success or obligatory-passage claim may use this as a city arrival/stay statistic until a Kandy-specific tourism dataset is found.
notes: Required measurement record intentionally remains U.
